decisive_items: purulent discharge in the sphenoethmoidal recess
soft tissue protruding through a breach in the lateral recess wall of the sphenoid sinus
response.rationale: The operative finding of a pyocele obstructing the sphenoid ostium, with purulent discharge and marsupialization, directly supports R10. R9 (sphenoid sinusitis) is broader and lacks the specific pyocele confirmation; other candidates (GPA, Tolosa-Hunt, osteomyelitis) are inconsistent with the purulent collection and surgical findings.

rejected.why: Mucocele is contradicted by purulent discharge and surgical pyocele; culture negativity does not exclude pyocele.
Granulomatosis with polyangiitis would typically show systemic features and not a purulent pyocele obstruction.
Pseudotumor is inflammatory but does not explain purulent discharge and surgical pyocele.
Sinusitis is too nonspecific; pyocele is the precise complication present.
No supportive evidence for allergic fungal sinusitis and cultures negative for fungi.
Abscess is less specific than pyocele; surgical finding was pyocele.
Tolosa-Hunt typically responds to steroids and lacks purulent collection.
GPA would show systemic/ANCA features and not a pyocele.
Osteomyelitis is not supported by the surgical and histological findings.
Trigeminal neuralgia was unresponsive to steroids and does not explain imaging/surgery.
No evidence of fungal elements on histopathology.
